newsitem.title: USA: Cognizant on track for FY96 growth target.
newsitem.headline: Cognizant on track for FY96 growth target.

text.p: Cognizant Corp, recently spun off from Dun & Bradstreet Corp, said on Tuesday it was on target to meet its forecasts of 17 to 20 percent earnings per share growth in 1996.
"Cognizant is demonstrating sustained, high growth," said Robert Weissman, Cognizant's chairman and chief executive officer. "We expect a strong finish in the fourth quarter, particularly from IMS."
IMS offers global information solutions to the pharmaceutical and healthcare industries.

In the most recent quarter, the company said this division benefited from the strong performance of its core sales territory management services and its SNAP/Pharma electronic territory management, as well as from geographic expansion in Eastern Europe and Asia Pacific.
In the third quarter 1996, the company earned $0.37 per share, before a $0.10 per share charge, against $0.31 per share in the same period last year.
